the converter has the following advantages: 1) ZVS operation is achieved by operating the switch in boundary conduction mode; 2) variable frequency with fixed off-time is used to improve the performance of the converter; 3) non-dissipating LC snubber circuit can be used for restraining the voltage spike effectively; 4) the converter can operate with wide input voltage variation.
